item.title: Southwest flood damage estimates are hundreds of millions for New Mexico alone
item.description: Intense rainstorms linked to a very active El Niño-driven Pacific hurricane season have left thousands of people in the Four Corners states displaced.

item.title: Israel's election turnout soars, lifting opposition hopes of beating Netanyahu
item.description: Israelis voted in their highest numbers in over two decades in a tense national election to decide whether to stick with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's far-right coalition.
item.content:encoded:
Israelis voted in their highest numbers in over two decades in a tense national election to decide whether to stick with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's far-right coalition.

item.title: The Ebola outbreak is breaking records -- and just marked a grim milestone
item.description: The current outbreak, first identified in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has now counted 10,000 patients and has spread with great speed. How can it be stopped?

item.title: A judge halted D.C. golf course renovations. Trump says they'll still start next month
item.description: A federal judge has barred the government from clearing more trees or making other alterations to D.C.'s East Potomac Park without proper notice. Trump says his administration will appeal.

item.title: Bolsonaro's party accepts Brazil election defeat, but he refuses to concede
item.description: Brazil's opposition party accepts President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's election victory, but Flávio Bolsonaro won't concede, while President Trump calls the vote "rigged" without offering evidence.
